title: Weight loss too fast on a cut — raise calories / reduce expenditure

weight.summary: 7 valid points over 14 days; sustained loss ≈ 900 g/week ≈ 1.5 %BW/week

expectations.assert: loss rate 1.5 %BW/week exceeds the athlete band 0.5–1 %/week with performance+recovery decline
proposal: changeCalories(positive) — increase — OR reduce expenditure (steps/volume hold-or-down); NEVER a further reduction
priorityClass = safety-or-recovery (outranks goalProgress); single major slot
ValidDecisionSpace: further calorie reductions and step increases blocked while the rate condition holds; reason codes visible
